resources.string: Shows a local hint when an incoming message you view contains a configured keyword. Messages stay visible. The same message is not repeatedly announced during this session.
Detected keyword “%1$s”. Possible scam risk — please be careful!

Add one keyword per line, up to 200 keywords of 80 characters each. Latin letters are case insensitive. These keywords supplement the remote list for this account and remain after updates. An empty list clears only your additions.
Clear the additional keywords for this account? The remote or bundled list will still apply.
The remote list has not been downloaded yet. Using the bundled keywords.
Update failed. The current keyword list is still in use. Tap Update keywords now to retry.

When alerts are enabled, the app reads the remote keyword list every 2 hours. System power saving may delay background updates. Opening the app also checks for overdue updates. Failed updates keep the last saved list.

Counts successfully sent and received messages stored on this device, within the selected local dates. Missing or cleared history is not fetched from Telegram. Frequency includes days with no messages.
Unable to read local data. Please retry.
No locally stored messages in this range.
Save a chat to the memorial
Saved. Open Message memorial in Extension features to read it.
Nothing saved: this chat has no readable local history, or storage is unavailable.

Keep private, read-only snapshots of unavailable accounts or channels, or any chat you choose. Snapshots and already downloaded attachments remain after a restart or clearing the original chat. Long-press a memorial to delete only its local snapshot.
No memorials yet. Save a chat with locally stored messages.
Includes local history of unavailable peers. Unavailable accounts and channels appear first. You can also save a chat before leaving or deleting it.

Save all messages currently stored on this device and copy downloaded attachments into a private, read-only snapshot. Undownloaded media cannot be recovered later from this snapshot. No messages are sent or changed.
Permanently delete this local snapshot and its copied attachments? The original chat will remain unchanged.
This is an independent local snapshot. Tap a message to read its full text or open its saved attachment. Sending, editing and forwarding are unavailable.
